A '''krugga deer''' was a creature of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].

C. [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], [[Guther Bartyn]] was hunting and tracked a krugga deer to the [[Krakana's Maw]] range. Then, he lost his prey.
